articles.summary: Global government bond markets experienced a second consecutive monthly sell-off in August. All 18 tracked 10-year benchmark yields rose, with 15 recording double-digit increases, as persistent inflation concerns and expectations that interest rates could remain higher for longer weighed on markets.
articles.title: Tradeweb Government Bond Update – August 2026

articles.summary: Discover how Tradeweb brings together liquidity across rates and credit, giving traders greater flexibility to execute multi-leg strategies across markets. Will Brayshaw and Elizabeth Ince explain how non-contingent trading makes this possible.
articles.title: Non-Contingent Cross-Market Workflows On Tradeweb
